description:
The Kalinga Sikhya Sathi Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Odisha in India. 

This scheme was launched on 27th June 2021. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to students pursuing higher education. 

The primary objective of the Kalinga Sikhya Sathi Yojana is to ensure that no deserving student is deprived of higher education due to financial constraints. 

The scheme specifically targets students from economically weaker sections of society. 

Under this initiative, the government provides educational loans to students. 

The maximum loan amount available under this scheme is INR 40,000 per year. 

The total loan amount can go up to INR 1,60,000 for the entire duration of the course. 

The interest rate on these loans is set at a nominal rate of 1% per annum. 

The repayment period for the loan is structured over a period of 10 years. 

Students can avail of this loan for various courses such as engineering, medical, management, and other professional courses. 

The scheme covers students studying in both government and private institutions. 

To be eligible for the Kalinga Sikhya Sathi Yojana, students must be residents of Odisha. 

They must have completed their higher secondary education. 

The annual family income of the applicant should not exceed INR 6,00,000. 

Students must also have secured admission to a recognized institution for higher studies. 

The application process for the Kalinga Sikhya Sathi Yojana is straightforward. 

Students need to visit the official website of the Odisha government. 

They must fill out the online application form available on the portal. 

Required documents include aadhar card, income certificate, and admission proof. 

Students must also submit their educational certificates. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

Eligible applicants are then granted the loan amount. 

The disbursement of funds is done directly to the educational institution. 

This ensures that the amount is utilized solely for educational purposes. 

The Kalinga Sikhya Sathi Yojana also includes provisions for loan waivers. 

In certain cases, students who complete their education successfully may have a portion of their loan waived off. 

This is particularly beneficial for students who excel in their studies. 

The scheme has been well-received since its launch. 

It aims to increase the enrollment rate in higher education institutions in Odisha. 

The government has set a target to increase the enrollment rate by 10% in the next five years. 

As of the latest reports, over 10,000 students have benefited from the scheme in its initial year. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Odisha. 

The department is responsible for overseeing the application process and disbursement of loans. 

Students can contact the department for any queries related to the scheme. 

The official contact number for the Department of Higher Education is +91-674-239-1780. 

The email address for inquiries is dheodisha@gmail.com. 

The Kalinga Sikhya Sathi Yojana is part of the larger initiative by the Odisha government to promote education. 

It aligns with the national goal of increasing the Gross Enrollment Ratio in higher education. 

The scheme also aims to reduce the dropout rate among students from economically weaker sections. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 100 crores for the implementation of this scheme in the first year. 

This budget is expected to increase in subsequent years based on the demand for loans. 

The Kalinga Sikhya Sathi Yojana is a significant step towards making higher education accessible. 

It empowers students to pursue their academic goals without the burden of financial constraints. 

The scheme is expected to contribute to the overall development of the state. 

By enhancing educational opportunities, it aims to improve the socio-economic status of families. 

The government also plans to conduct awareness programs about the scheme. 

These programs will be held in various educational institutions across the state. 

The aim is to ensure that eligible students are aware of the benefits available to them. 

The Kalinga Sikhya Sathi Yojana is a commendable effort by the Odisha government. 

It reflects the commitment to promoting education and supporting students. 

The scheme has the potential to transform the educational landscape in Odisha. 

It encourages students to pursue higher education and achieve their career aspirations. 

In summary, the Kalinga Sikhya Sathi Yojana is a comprehensive financial assistance program. 

It is designed to support students in Odisha in their pursuit of higher education. 

With specific eligibility criteria and a straightforward application process, it aims to empower the youth. 

The nominal interest rate and the possibility of loan waivers make it an attractive option. 

The scheme is a crucial initiative towards building a knowledgeable and skilled workforce in the state. 

It is a vital step in ensuring that education is not a privilege but a right for all.
